name: Garlicky Roasted Tomatoes with Feta, Sesame Seeds & Pita Bread
instructions: Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Place in a small baking dish, just large enough to fit the tomatoes in a single layer.
Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle garlic and feta evenly over the tomatoes.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and spices over the feta, then drizzle with oil.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until tomatoes have softened and juices start to bubble, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, cut pita breads into wedges and arrange on a baking sheet pan. When the tomatoes are almost done, add pita bread to the oven and bake until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Divide roasted tomatoes and feta between plates. Serve with warm pita bread. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
